hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])terraform[[:space:]]+apply([[:space:]]|$)' && grep -q 'Overall Status: FAIL' reports/tf-drift-report.txt 2>/dev/null; then echo 'BLOCKED: terraform apply is not permitted because the latest drift report has Overall Status: FAIL' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
